=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:3268-3327 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: In `_merge_lease_gate_multi`, when a live holder's files now overlap an earlier holder, the merge-mode holder branch calls `_merge_lease_gate_multi_wait`, which runs `_merge_lease_label_wait` and labels the PR `ai:merge-lease-wait`, but nothing re-dispatches a labelled PR that is still a holder: `_mt_merge_lease_tick_multi` (scripts/review_merge_train.sh:1992-2016) adds every live holder to `tm_excluded`, so `_merge_lease_queue_first` never selects, unlabels or re-dispatches it, and the sweep skips labelled PRs (.github/workflows/review_autofix_sweep.yml:749-751).
  WHY: Once the earlier holder releases, the approved PR stalls and keeps a `MERGE_LEASE_MAX_HOLDERS` slot until TTL expiry or `revoked_idle`. After that, a `skip_head_unchanged` skip entry keeps it labelled until the D4 empty-queue handback. This state could not occur before the last run, and `test_holder_that_grew_onto_an_earlier_holder_waits_in_merge_mode` locks the label in. Severity is MAJOR from 4 reviewers; google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite stated no severity.
- changelog.d/merge-lease-parallel-p5-multi-holder.md:2 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: The changelog says "A value that is not a whole number uses 1 with a warning". It omits that a value with more than three digits (e.g. `1000`) also uses 1, and this disagrees with the corrected README and with `_merge_lease_max_holders` (`^[0-9]{1,3}$`).
  WHY: The documentation is wrong, not the code. A consumer who sets a 4-digit value expecting a clamp to 5 gets 1 holder and a warning. Severity is NIT.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:`_merge_lease_gate_multi` merge-mode holder branch (`_merge_lease_gate_multi_wait "${gm_pr}" "${gm_base}" merge holder_shares_paths "${gm_h}"; return 1`); caller at pr_checks_lib.sh:1941-1947 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: A live holder that overlaps an earlier holder gets a merge-mode wait, and `_merge_lease_label_wait` adds `ai:merge-lease-wait` to its PR. The sweep skips labelled PRs (`.github/workflows/review_autofix_sweep.yml:749`, `AUTOFIX_SWEEP_SKIP ... reason=merge_lease_wait`). `_mt_merge_lease_tick_multi` appends every live row to `tm_excluded`, so the grant path's `_merge_lease_unlabel_wait` and `_mt_dispatch_review` never run for it. The `lease_wait` message promises a re-dispatch that never comes.
  WHY: Example with holders 8 and 9: PR 9 waits and is labelled. PR 8 merges and is released (`holder_closed`), and 9 is then logged `outcome=held reason=holder_open` on every pass. 9 holds a slot without renewing until TTL or `revoked_idle`. Its skip entry `9:<head>` then stays `skip_head_unchanged`, and the label is removed only on the D4 path (`tm_queue_empty=1`, `tm_granted=0`). This state is new since the last run, and the test locks in the label (`self.assertIn("ai:merge-lease-wait", h.state["labels"]["9"])`). Suggested fix: log and emit the metric without calling `_merge_lease_label_wait`, or have the tick unlabel and re-dispatch a labelled live holder that no earlier holder overlaps, and update the test.
- changelog.d/merge-lease-parallel-p5-multi-holder.md:line 2 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: "A value that is not a whole number uses 1 with a warning." is out of date: the README and `test_max_holders_validation` (`("1234", "1", True)`) say a value with more than three digits also uses 1.
  WHY: Documentation only. A consumer setting a 4-digit value expecting a clamp to 5 gets 1 holder.
- HARDENING_SUGGESTION scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:`_merge_lease_gate_multi` update-mode renewal fallback (`if ! gm_own_paths="$(_merge_lease_pr_paths "${gm_pr}" 2>/dev/null)"; then gm_own_paths="$(_merge_lease_holder_paths "${gm_pr}")"; fi`) | HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
  PROBLEM: With 2+ holders and missing `holder_path=` lines, the fallback uses the union `MERGE_LEASE_PATHS`, so the renewing holder takes on every other holder's paths. This fails closed (extra waits).
  WHY: Suggested fix: when `MERGE_LEASE_HOLDER_COUNT` > 1 and there is no line for `gm_pr`, use `*`, or document the behaviour. About 3 lines.
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:_merge_lease_gate_multi() merge-mode overlap check (lines 3314-3327) | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: A merge-mode holder that shares a path with an earlier holder is labelled `ai:merge-lease-wait` by `_merge_lease_gate_multi_wait`, but `_mt_merge_lease_tick_multi` has no mechanism to unlabel or re-dispatch a live holder once the earlier holder is released.
  WHY: The PR stays labelled, is skipped by the sweep (`merge_train_skip_active`), and stays stalled until the lease expires or `revoked_idle` fires, which hurts merge-train throughput.
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:`_merge_lease_gate_multi` merge-mode holder branch; scripts/review_merge_train.sh `_mt_merge_lease_tick_multi` (`tm_excluded += tm_h` loop) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: A holder that overlaps an earlier holder's paths waits in merge mode and is labelled `ai:merge-lease-wait`. On every tick it is kept as `outcome=held reason=holder_open holders=<n>` and added to `tm_excluded`, so `_merge_lease_queue_first` never re-grants, unlabels or re-dispatches it. The `skip_head_unchanged` unlabel branch applies only to revoked waiters.
  WHY: The approved PR stalls and holds a `MERGE_LEASE_MAX_HOLDERS` slot for up to ~12h (`MERGE_LEASE_MAX_HOLD_MINUTES` default 720, or `MERGE_LEASE_IDLE_MINUTES` default 60), blocking disjoint waiters. The sweep skips it (`.github/workflows/review_autofix_sweep.yml:749`), and `test_holder_that_grew_onto_an_earlier_holder_waits_in_merge_mode` in `tests/test_merge_lease.py` locks the stall in. This behaviour is new since the last run.
- HARDENING_SUGGESTION scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:`_merge_lease_gate_multi` update-mode renewal fallback | HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
  PROBLEM: In a multi-holder record with dropped `holder_path=` lines, `_merge_lease_holder_paths` falls back to the union `MERGE_LEASE_PATHS`, which widens the renewing holder's recorded footprint.
  WHY: Suggested fix: when `MERGE_LEASE_HOLDER_COUNT` > 1 and the PR has no per-holder paths, set `gm_own_paths="*"`. About 3 lines.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:`_merge_lease_gate_multi` merge-mode holder branch, via `_merge_lease_label_wait` at scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:3268 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: A holder that overlaps an earlier holder (record order) is labelled `ai:merge-lease-wait`, but nothing recovers it. The sweep skips it (.github/workflows/review_autofix_sweep.yml:749-751). The `_mt_merge_lease_tick_multi` grant loop adds every live holder to `tm_excluded`, so `_merge_lease_queue_first` never selects, unlabels or re-dispatches it, and it logs `outcome=held reason=holder_open holders=<n>` on every tick.
  WHY: The labelled holder keeps a slot, and its merge attempts are deferred on `lease_wait` (`.github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:1508-1510, 1522-1524, 1551-1553, 1565-1567`). It exits only through `revoked_idle` or expiry, and the `skip_head_unchanged` skip entry then blocks re-grant until the D4 handback. This state is new since the last run, and the test locks the label in. Suggested fix: wait without the label, or have the tick unlabel and re-dispatch the holder, and update the test.
=== END FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
